provenance.prompt:
Generate filler lines for an archive-catalog retrieval test. Produce 120 short sentences. Vary the WORDING and sentence structure HEAVILY, but every line must be in EXACTLY one of these two roles:
- [about 75% of lines] State the CATALOG NUMBER of a specific named manuscript OTHER than 'Meridian'. The line must make clear the code IS that manuscript's catalog number (e.g. "The Halcyon manuscript's catalog number is AB-1234-CD", "Halcyon is cataloged as AB-1234-CD", "Catalog no. AB-1234-CD — the Halcyon manuscript"). Invent diverse manuscript names; use varied codes shaped AB-1234-CD. Do NOT present the code as the manuscript's name/title/ID — it is specifically the CATALOG NUMBER.
- [about 25% of lines] State a NON-catalog attribute (storage box number, shelf/aisle, page count, or donor) of the 'Meridian' manuscript.

HARD CONSTRAINTS:
1. NEVER state a catalog number for the 'Meridian' manuscript.
2. NEVER use the exact code QX-7793-LK.
Output ONE sentence per line. No numbering, no headers, no commentary.
